scope: fixed observed inputs with hidden random seed or experimental repeat scatter

papers.title: Gen-Fab: A Variation-Aware Generative Model for Predicting Fabrication Variations in Nanophotonic Devices
papers.model: Pix2Pix U-Net bottleneck에 16차원 latent noise를 주입한 conditional GAN. adversarial+L1 손실로 명목 layout에서 제작 후 영상의 조건부 분포를 학습.
papers.sample: 입력: 동일 GDS layout. 숨겨진 변동: lithography·etching 및 영상 취득 편차. 출력: 반복 제작된 실리콘 nanophotonic 구조의 SEM형 영상. 실제 220 nm SOI 제작 데이터.
papers.evidence: 31 GDS–SEM pair를 회전 증강해 124 pair로 훈련. 다른 분포의 Cross/Square/Target 6종에서 실제 반복 35개씩 비교. variance map, intensity histogram KL/Wasserstein; OOD random-match IoU 88.7%, greedy 89.8%. Table 2 Cross-25 KL=0.2657, W=0.1693.
papers.ood: 훈련 random Fourier patterns와 다른 primitive 형상. VGG feature 거리로 train/test shift를 별도 확인.
papers.verdict: 가장 직접적인 실측 제작 산포 선례. C1 확인, C2는 영상 intensity 요약 분포로 제한, C3 형상 OOD 확인. 전체 공간 joint geometry law나 광학성능 분포의 일치를 입증한 것은 아님.

papers.title: GUST: Quantifying Free-Form Geometric Uncertainty of Metamaterials Using Small Data
papers.model: U-Net/attention/SPADE conditional DDPM. 합성 geometric perturbation pretraining 후 실제 제작 사진으로 fine-tuning. 생성 geometry를 homogenization solver에 전달.
papers.sample: 입력: 동일 nominal unit-cell geometry. 출력: boundary deformation/dilation 등이 다른 as-fabricated geometry와 그 형상으로 계산한 elastic tensor. 실제 SLA resin 2 mm extrusion 시편 사진, 64×64 representation.
papers.evidence: 사진 처리 후 17 designs×64 cells 유지. 15 designs/960 cells로 fine-tune, 2 unseen designs/128 cells로 평가. 실제 형상에서 계산한 C11/C12/C22/C33 KDE 비교. 합성 검증은 30 designs×3000 variants, density/coverage/Wasserstein.
papers.ood: test nominal designs는 pretraining 및 fine-tuning에 없음. nearest training geometry와 >25% pixel 차이. 같은 design family 내 형상 holdout이며 실제 제작 도메인으로 적응한 모델.
papers.verdict: C1 확인, C2 approximate, C3 제한된 geometry holdout. 실제 물성 시험의 산포가 아니라 실측 형상에서 계산한 물성 산포. 합성 coverage는 중간 수준이며 생성 분포가 좁다고 저자가 명시; 실제 평가의 KDE를 완전 일치로 부를 수 없음.

papers.title: Microstructure-based variational deep material networks for robust uncertainty quantification in materials digital twins
papers.model: VDMN: mechanistic laminate homogenization tree의 orientation/volume-fraction parameters를 확률분포로 학습. elastic stiffness likelihood와 analytic moment propagation으로 훈련; sampling하여 nonlinear constitutive responses 생성.
papers.sample: 입력: constituent phase properties 및 동일 loading 조건. 숨겨진 변동: 같은 statistical descriptors를 갖는 다른 microstructure realization. 출력: homogenized stiffness 또는 nonlinear stress–strain response. FFT/DNS 30개 microstructure ensemble과 3D printed two-phase polymer tensile specimens.
papers.evidence: Fig.2 고정 phase-property input별 30 reference outputs와 25 VDMN samples/PDF, rank calibration. Fig.3 nonlinear response histograms. Fig.4 12 printed tensile specimens와 두 strain 수준의 stress marginals 비교.
papers.ood: linear-elastic 훈련에서 nonlinear constitutive law 및 loading으로 전이. 알려진 nonlinear law를 inference 단계에서 교체하는 physics 기반 일반화. Fig.2의 input들은 convex hull 안에 있음.
papers.verdict: 정적 material-response 산포의 중요한 선례이나 C2에 큰 한계. nonlinear 1% strain에서 SD MRAE tension 57.9%, shear 33.4%. Supplement S5는 실험 12개를 max-min으로 선택해 reference distribution을 더 uniform하게 편향시켰다고 명시. 동일 CAD의 자연 반복 제작 빈도와 완전한 OOD joint-law 재현을 입증한 사례로 쓰기 어려움.

papers.title: Stochastic deep material networks as efficient surrogates for stochastic homogenisation of non-linear heterogeneous materials
papers.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 441:117994
papers.access: 출판사 본문 excerpt, 저자 기관 repository와 공개 data record 확인; 전문 다운로드 실패
papers.model: Interaction-Based DMN에서 phase volume fraction과 topology를 분리하고 reference network topology에 확률 변동을 도입. linear elastic homogenization 훈련을 nonlinear material uncertainty propagation으로 확장.
papers.sample: 고정 phase properties/volume fraction/loading에서 random SVE fiber organization 및 clustering으로 달라지는 effective response. 실제 반복 실험이 아닌 numerical homogenization.
papers.evidence: 확률적 microstructure response를 DNS와 비교하며 공개 data에는 6 SVE geometry 및 nonlinear stochastic analyses 포함. 세부 PDF distance 값은 이번 접근 범위에서 검증하지 못함.
papers.ood: arbitrary volume fraction 및 nonlinear response capability를 기술. 명시적 train/test support-OOD 분포 비교는 확인하지 못함.
papers.verdict: 직접적인 stochastic material-response surrogate 선례. C1/C2는 공개 primary 설명으로 확인하는 수준, C3 및 정확한 분포 성능은 미확인.

papers.title: Predicting Stress–Strain Curve with Confidence: Balance Between Data Minimization and Uncertainty Quantification by a Dual Bayesian Model
papers.access: primary 전문 index의 방법 및 검증 내용 확인
papers.model: curve-type categorical classifier와 curve-feature normal mean/SD regression을 결합. Bayesian weights의 epistemic uncertainty와 feature-output aleatoric uncertainty를 분리하고 spline로 curve 재구성.
papers.sample: 고정 4개 injection molding condition에서 다른 isotactic polypropylene tensile specimen의 curve type, yield/fracture feature 및 stress–strain curve. 27 Taguchi conditions, 각 3–7 실험 반복; 23°C, 50 mm/min.
papers.evidence: feature probability calibration, prediction intervals 및 curve-type frequencies. test type 예측 70%/30%, 실험 83%/17%; calibration area 약 0.11 aleatoric/0.18 total.
papers.ood: classifier 25 conditions train/2 test, regression 26/1; 저자는 extrapolation으로 기술. 광범위한 다른 생산 regime 검증은 아님.
papers.verdict: 실측 동일 공정 조건 산포에 매우 가까움. C2는 feature marginals와 type probability. C1 full random realistic curve ensemble 및 joint-curve distribution 검증은 제한, C3는 소수 조건 holdout.

papers.title: Generative Hyperelasticity with Physics-Informed Probabilistic Diffusion Fields
papers.model: Polyconvex strain-energy NODE의 sample-specific weights를 diffusion으로 생성. correlated latent로 spatial material-property fields도 만들고 FEM에 전달.
papers.sample: 동일 prescribed deformation에서 달라지는 material stress–stretch curve 및 strain-energy function. synthetic 10000 material population, 실제 15 mice skin의 off-X/off-Y/equibiaxial tests.
papers.evidence: 생성 constitutive curves, stress-at-stretch distributions, energy distance, synthetic parameter joint KDE 비교. 샘플별 polyconvexity를 구조적으로 확보.
papers.ood: 새 P-shaped specimen 등의 FEM 사례는 uncertainty propagation demonstration. 새로운 material/geometry의 실제 reference distribution과 대조한 OOD 평가 없음.
papers.verdict: C1 확인, C2 확인하되 실측 15개로 population/tail 정확도는 제한. C3 없음. condition-dependent shape surrogate라기보다 material-population law와 deformation에 대한 응답 sampling.

papers.title: AlloyVAE: A generative model for complex probabilistic field-to-field relationships in alloys
papers.model: composition/SRO smoothing과 encoder self-check를 갖는 conditional VAE. coarse field 조건에서 latent sampling으로 stress fields 생성.
papers.sample: 동일 CoCrNi composition 및 short-range-order field에서 숨겨진 atomic arrangement에 의해 다른 정적 residual stress fields. MD를 coarse 4³ blocks로 평균한 데이터.
papers.evidence: 동일 input에서 3–5 generated fields. reconstruction MRE 5.4%, R² 약 0.96. 보고된 pooled histogram은 posterior reconstruction과 target 비교.
papers.ood: 명시적 OOD train/test shift 확인되지 않음.
papers.verdict: 문제 자체는 정확한 static one-to-many. C1 확인, C2 prior-generated conditional ensemble 검증 부족, C3 미확인. self-check <4%를 stress-distribution fidelity로 해석하면 안 됨.

papers.title: Equivariant Flow Matching for Symmetry-Breaking Bifurcation Problems
papers.model: equivariant GNN/U-Net flow matching과 symmetry matching으로 symmetry-breaking solution branches의 분포를 생성.
papers.sample: 동일 beam parameters 및 compression에서 좌/우 buckling branch와 quasi-static deformation paths. branch를 eigenmode perturbation으로 선택한 numerical data; Allen–Cahn benchmark도 포함.
papers.evidence: Fig.1 50 generated paths, Table 1 100 samples의 Wasserstein distance. beam plain FM 43.2에서 symmetry matching 14.8로 개선(논문 단위).
papers.ood: 명시적 parameter-range/geometry distribution shift 검증 확인 못함.
papers.verdict: C1/C2 numerical branch distribution 확인, C3 미확인. branch probability의 reference는 symmetry-equivalent allowable solutions; 실제 manufacturing imperfection이 유도하는 branch 발생빈도를 학습한 것으로 확장하면 안 됨.

papers.title: Predictive microstructure image generation using denoising diffusion probabilistic models
papers.access: 출판사 전문 index 및 방법/검증 내용 확인
papers.model: process embeddings를 multi-resolution attention U-Net에 주입하는 DDPM.
papers.sample: 동일 cast-forging process/magnification 조건에서 가능한 AZ80 Mg SEM microstructure images. 11 I-beam components의 27 metallographic samples, 131 image classes.
papers.evidence: 512×512 samples, FID 및 DRX grain/phase descriptors. unseen morphology error 6.67±0.85%, seen 6.36±0.42%; physical descriptors는 조건별 적어도 10 images.
papers.ood: 17 classes(13%) withheld; 한 component의 samples, 다른 component의 한 sample 및 추가 magnification을 포함하는 조합 holdout.
papers.verdict: C1 확인, C2는 image/within-image morphology statistics, C3 process-combination/magnification holdout. 동일 조건의 specimen-level engineering-response law를 검증한 것은 아님.

papers.title: Physics-informed machine learning enabled virtual experimentation for 3D printed thermoplastic
papers.access: primary 전문 index의 방법 및 검증 내용 확인
papers.model: MLP와 8-component PCA curve representation. formulation/molecular descriptors에 fracture-strain variation parameter e_value를 결합.
papers.sample: 동일 ink formulation에서 달라지는 tensile stress–strain response. 62 formulations, 각 2–4 actual curves; 50 formulations/180 curves train, 12/36 test.
papers.evidence: e=-2…2로 curve ranges 생성, 실제 curves 및 fracture/toughness metrics 비교. e는 actual fracture strain으로부터 산출된 target-informed variation rank.
papers.ood: heldout formulations/추가 실험은 있으나 명확한 support-OOD distribution protocol은 확인 못함.
papers.verdict: C1 curve variability illustration, C2 독립 conditional sample distribution validation 부족. target-derived e_value와 실제 배포 latent sampling을 구분해야 함.

papers.title: Sim-to-real diffusion models for microstructure prediction in metal additive manufacturing
papers.model: CFD/phase-field images pretraining 후 실제 EBSD로 fine-tuning 및 distillation하는 conditional DDPM.
papers.sample: 고정 laser power/speed에서 다른 316L grain microstructures. simulation 및 실제 AM EBSD images.
papers.evidence: 조건별 generated images FID와 grain width/length/area/aspect distributions 비교.
papers.ood: 새 experimental conditions이지만 해당 conditions가 simulation pretraining에는 포함됨.
papers.verdict: C1 확인, C2 morphology statistics, C3 experimental-domain transfer. 모든 훈련 데이터에서 unseen condition인 zero-shot OOD로 해석할 수 없음.

papers.title: Data-efficient continuous conditional denoising diffusion model for microstructure generation
papers.model: condition-dependent covariance embeddings, vicinal loss 및 classifier-free guidance를 갖는 continuous conditional DDPM.
papers.sample: 같은 low-carbon steel Mn composition/cooling schedule에서 초기 grain/CA seed에 따라 다른 ferrite/austenite final maps. 40000 simulated images, 256×256.
papers.evidence: 10 unseen Mn values에서 각 100 generated+100 CA reference images. grain size/count, phase fraction/interface/banding KDE 비교.
papers.ood: Mn .0021–.0220 내부의 새 값; 주로 interpolation.
papers.verdict: C1/C2 numerical microstructure-statistics 확인. C3 genuine distribution-shift/extrapolation 검증 없음; 높은 Mn에서 오차 인정.

papers.title: Controllable data augmentation and application of multiaxial fatigue experiments by fatigue conditional generative adversative network model
papers.access: 출판사 abstract/본문 excerpt 확인; 전문 미확보
papers.model: strain-path conditional CNN GAN with Wasserstein loss (FatCGAN).
papers.sample: 동일 multiaxial strain-controlled loading에서 316L stainless steel stress response 및 fatigue life samples. 실제 fatigue experiments.
papers.evidence: abstract는 qualitative/quantitative generated-versus-experimental distribution consistency를 보고. augmented data로 downstream RMSE 개선.
papers.ood: heldout loading regime 또는 조건별 반복 표본 상세가 접근 가능한 primary 내용에 없음.
papers.verdict: 직접적인 experimental one-to-many 후보. C1/C2 주장 있음, C3 및 정확한 conditional PDF protocol 미확인; 완전충족으로 인증할 수 없음.

papers.title: Probabilistic physics-guided machine learning for fatigue data analysis
papers.access: 출판사 primary abstract 및 저자 기관 내용 확인
papers.model: PPgNN: fatigue-life conditional mean/variance에 monotonicity/curvature constraints를 주고 failure/runout likelihood로 학습.
papers.sample: 같은 stress/loading/environment conditions에서 다른 specimen fatigue lives. 여러 실제 S–N datasets; mean stress/corrosion/frequency extension.
papers.evidence: probabilistic P-S-N fitting, variance and derivative consistency를 실제 data로 검증.
papers.ood: physics-consistent extrapolation formulation은 있으나 heldout OOD의 empirical conditional PDF 검증 미확인.
papers.verdict: scalar life scatter를 직접 다루는 AI/통계 혼합 선례. C1 분포에서 수치 sampling 가능, C2 parametric P-S-N/interval evidence, C3 미확인.

papers.title: Physics-guided mixture density networks for uncertainty quantification
papers.access: primary publisher 내용 및 저자 공개본 내용 확인; 전체 출판사 PDF 미확보
papers.model: PgMDN: neural network가 conditional mixture weights/means/scales를 예측. physical statistical/derivative constraints를 dynamic penalties로 부과. censored observations를 likelihood에 포함.
papers.sample: fatigue stress/strain 및 부식 등 관측 변수 고정에서 다른 life. bridge frequency 등의 engineering cases도 포함.
papers.evidence: single-Gaussian과 다른 skewed/multimodal/truncated law를 표현; fatigue P-S-N distributions 및 probabilistic score validation.
papers.ood: 명시적인 support-OOD conditional distribution comparison은 확인 못함.
papers.verdict: 고정 input의 비정규 산포를 학습하는 직접적인 predecessor. 이론적 mixture expressivity와 실제 full-law equality를 구분할 필요.

papers.title: Fatigue property prediction of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V using probabilistic physics-guided learning
papers.access: 저자 전문 및 기관 record 확인
papers.model: PPgNN: log fatigue life의 conditional Gaussian mean/SD, S–N physics constraints, runouts와 missing process data handling.
papers.sample: same stress ratio/amplitude 및 scan speed/power/hatch/layer/heat treatment에서 defect/material variability에 따른 fatigue life. 11 references의 18 experimental datasets.
papers.evidence: 6 complete+12 incomplete datasets; leave-complete-dataset-out folds, P-S-N predictions 및 log scores.
papers.ood: source/process dataset holdout이 있으나 일부 folds는 같은 processing parameters를 공유. 모든 fold를 genuine process-OOD라 할 수 없음.
papers.verdict: 실제 제조·수명 산포의 명확한 선례. C2 conditional parametric calibration/interval evidence, large repeated-condition empirical PDF comparison은 없음.

papers.title: Data-driven approaches for fatigue prediction of Ti–6Al–4V parts fabricated by laser powder bed fusion
papers.access: primary author institutional record/abstract 확인; 상세 전문 검증 제한
papers.model: PPgNN 2.0 Gaussian mean/SD with physics constraints, crack-initiation classifier.
papers.sample: LPBF Ti-6Al-4V loading/process/morphology에서 fatigue lives. literature training과 independent in-house fatigue tests/CT imaging.
papers.evidence: external experimental assessment 및 probabilistic mean/SD output. same-condition empirical density matching 지표는 확인되지 않음.
papers.ood: 외부 시험기관/제작 데이터 검증 후보; exact support/condition split은 미확인.
papers.verdict: 우선 추가 전문 확인할 후보. external test가 있다는 사실만으로 full conditional distribution OOD validation이라 부를 수 없음.

papers.title: Estimating Fatigue Curves with the Random Fatigue-Limit Model
papers.model: specimen-specific random fatigue limit와 life noise를 포함하는 statistical likelihood model. runouts를 censoring으로 처리; conditional CDF/survival law를 도출.
papers.sample: 동일 applied stress의 실제 specimens에서 다른 fatigue lives 및 failure하지 않을 확률. laminate panel 예시: 5 stress levels×25 specimens.
papers.evidence: conditional CDF, probability plots, empirical distribution/KS 및 residual goodness-of-fit. 분포에서 실제 수명 samples를 수치적으로 추출 가능.
papers.ood: heldout stress/새 material regime에 대한 독립 OOD 실험은 확인되지 않음.
papers.verdict: 생성 이미지가 없는 오래된 통계모델도 user 정의의 scalar one-to-many에 해당. C2 repeat-experiment law 검증, C3 없음.

papers.title: Predicting critical heat flux with uncertainty quantification and domain generalization using conditional variational autoencoders and deep neural networks
papers.model: conditional VAE encoder/decoder and DNN ensemble comparator.
papers.sample: 동일 7 thermal-hydraulic/geometry variables에서 scalar CHF; fixed condition에서 200 latent draws. NRC real experimental database.
papers.evidence: predicted-mean errors, relative SD 및 error histogram. generated CHF conditional distribution을 repeated measurement distribution과 비교한 것이 아님.
papers.ood: test 1411 cases outside training convex hull, 1047 inside. support-OOD 확인.
papers.verdict: C1 random output 생성 및 C3 확인. C2 실제 aleatoric law fidelity는 미입증. 작은 latent spread/정확한 mean은 correct physical scatter의 증거가 아님.

papers.title: Development of physics-consistent conditional diffusion model to overcome data scarcity in critical heat flux
papers.model: unconditional tabular diffusion과 conditional CHF diffusion. 조건부 모델은 5 TH inputs에서 CHF를 생성.
papers.sample: fixed pressure/mass flux/diameter/heated length/outlet quality→scalar CHF, 500 noise draws. NRC 24579 measurements, 59 studies.
papers.evidence: unconditional joint data의 marginal/correlation/ECDF/KS validation은 있음. conditional model은 parity/relative SD/physics consistency 중심.
papers.ood: shuffled 80/10/10 split; genuine OOD 없음.
papers.verdict: C1 확인. unconditional joint-data realism을 fixed-x conditional law 재현으로 대신할 수 없음. C2 conditional validation 부족, C3 없음.

papers.title: Data efficiency assessment of generative adversarial networks in energy applications
papers.access: primary publisher indexed methods/results 및 author institution 확인
papers.model: conditional GAN / conditional WGAN with FNN latent generators; deterministic FNN baseline.
papers.sample: fixed 5 thermal/geometry variables→scalar CHF. 21453 real experimental data points.
papers.evidence: random holdout Case 1 KL 0.014 cGAN/0.011 wGAN. Case 2 cross-experiment에서는 mean MAPE/R² 중심.
papers.ood: 한 실험 source로 훈련, 다른 4 experiments 평가. 일부 OOD 매우 실패: Alekseev-trained cGAN MAPE 271.33%.
papers.verdict: C3가 실제 존재하는 중요 negative predecessor. pooled/random-case KL과 OOD mean-error를 합쳐 OOD conditional distribution match라고 하면 안 됨.

papers.title: Probabilistic Machine Learning Framework for Predicting Critical Heat Flux in Uniformly Heated Vertical Tubes with Uncertainty Quantification
papers.access: primary institutional abstract 확인; full text 미확보
papers.model: BNN and Natural Gradient Boosting (NGBoost)로 conditional mean 및 predictive distribution/uncertainty 추정.
papers.sample: tube conditions 고정에서 CHF scalar. NRC 24579 real experimental points.
papers.evidence: random 80/20 test의 nominal 95% intervals에 BNN 94.7%, NGBoost 93.9% 포함. predictive law의 전체 CDF/shape validation은 접근자료에 없음.
papers.ood: 별도 unseen dataset을 보고하지만 정확한 split 및 외부 law shift 미확인; NGBoost는 해당 unseen data에서 lookup table보다 못한 예외.
papers.verdict: 실험 scatter의 probabilistic regression 선례. coverage 하나로 전체 조건부 분포 일치를 입증한 것은 아님.

papers.title: A physics-constrained framework for fatigue data augmentation of post-weld treated joints: censored S–N estimation with an exploratory generative component
papers.model: Basquin backbone + CVAE conditional residual model, geometry/stress ratio/treatment/log-stress conditioning, generation-band filtering.
papers.sample: 동일 post-weld treatment/loading conditions→fatigue-life scalar. preprocessing 후 1476 experimental specimens.
papers.evidence: generated residual scatter 평균 0.83× empirical scatter; 일부 그룹만 KS/W criteria 충족. 23 study leave-one-study-out mean RMSE 0.4529→0.4670.
papers.ood: external-study holdout downstream regression 검증. OOD generated conditional life law의 직접 비교는 부족.
papers.verdict: 명확한 one-to-many 모형이나 분포 fidelity 및 augmentation benefit의 negative result. 실패/제한도 검증 결과로 기록해야 함.

papers.title: Probabilistic surrogate modeling of damage equivalent loads on onshore and offshore wind turbines using mixture density networks
papers.model: MDN이 Gaussian-mixture weights/means/scales를 입력의 함수로 예측. 각 load channel을 별도 모델링, ordinary GPR 비교.
papers.sample: 같은 mean wind speed/TI/shear 및 offshore sea statistics→scalar 10-minute DEL 또는 load SD. TurbSim/파랑 seed는 AI input에서 제외. OpenFAST reference.
papers.evidence: TEST1 50 conditions×300 reference seeds, TEST2 24×300 seeds. model 5000 draws/condition. conditional histogram, normalized W2, mean/SD/5%/95% quantiles. 동일 x에서 다봉성도 비교.
papers.ood: TEST1 bounds는 training과 동일; TEST2도 같은 domain. 별도 onshore/offshore models를 transfer-OOD로 셀 수 없음.
papers.verdict: user가 말한 random-seed one-to-many에 가장 정확한 AI 선례 중 하나. 모델이 시간 evolution을 forecasting하지 않고 scalar law를 직접 출력. C1/C2 strong numerical evidence, C3 없음. corrigendum은 DEL 계산식/주파수 설명 수정.

papers.title: Data-driven probabilistic surrogate model for floating wind turbine lifetime damage equivalent load prediction
papers.model: 4-component Gaussian MDN, seven metocean inputs→conditional DEL distribution.
papers.sample: same wind/wave statistics→6 MW floating wind turbine scalar loads; hidden turbulence/wave realization. BHawC–OrcaFlex numerical reference.
papers.evidence: 44 reference seed repetitions vs 5000 model draws at fixed conditions; PDFs/W2. blade-root/tower-top좋음, tower-bottom variance overestimated.
papers.ood: 4 sites의 lifetime assessment는 downstream deployment; external reference conditional distribution OOD validation 없음.
papers.verdict: C1/C2 strong but imperfect. temporal field model이 아닌 fixed-input engineering QoI law. C3 없음.

papers.title: Conditional variational autoencoders for probabilistic wind turbine blade fatigue estimation using SCADA data
papers.model: 15D latent CVAE from three coarse wind statistics to spatial distribution of blade-root cross-section DELs.
papers.sample: same SCADA/coarse wind statistics→273 cross-section load outputs; unresolved inflow realization. 2000 LiDAR-informed TurbSim/OpenFAST/BeamDyn simulations.
papers.evidence: generated load variation와 validation cases의 spatial scatter 비교. 고정 x large repeated-reference PDF 비교는 제한.
papers.ood: random 80/20 및 sparse-data evaluation; explicit distribution-shift split 없음.
papers.verdict: multi-output engineering sample generator 선례. C1 확인, C2 약함, C3 없음.

papers.title: Replication-based emulation of the response distribution of stochastic simulators using generalized lambda distributions
papers.model: 4 GLD parameters 각각 sparse PCE로 회귀. Uniform latent를 learned quantile function에 넣어 fixed-x output sampling.
papers.sample: fixed wind speed/TI/shear/density/inclination→5 MW turbine maximum blade-root flapwise bending moment. hidden TurbSim seeds로 서로 다른 출력.
papers.evidence: 485 training conditions×50 seeds, 120 test×500 seeds. Fig.19 fixed-x PDFs/histograms, Fig.17–18 quantiles/mean/SD.
papers.ood: test conditions sampled by same scheme as train.
papers.verdict: C1/C2 strong scalar statistical predecessor, C3 없음. 시간 궤적을 생성하지 않고 최종 scalar conditional law를 학습.

papers.title: Emulation of stochastic simulators using generalized lambda models
papers.access: primary abstract/journal info와 저자 전문 내용 확인
papers.model: GLD parameters를 PCE로 모델링하고 maximum conditional likelihood/feasible GLS를 결합. 각 x에서 replicated training 필요 없음.
papers.sample: 같은 observed simulator input에서 hidden random variables에 따라 달라지는 scalar law. 주요 benchmarks는 mathematical finance/epidemiology.
papers.evidence: conditional response distributions, mean/variance 및 normalized Wasserstein 비교.
papers.ood: genuine external-support OOD distribution evaluation 확인 못함.
papers.verdict: engineering application 선례보다 핵심 statistical-method predecessor. one observation/input인 훈련도 conditional law learning이 가능함을 보여줌; 반복 validation과 반복 training을 구분.

papers.title: Stochastic polynomial chaos expansions to emulate stochastic simulators
papers.model: PCE in observed X and artificial latent Z plus Gaussian smoothing noise. distributional likelihood로 coefficients 학습.
papers.sample: same x→random scalar, including bimodal benchmark. GBM/epidemiology는 방법론 사례이며 engineering specimens 아님.
papers.evidence: reference/generated PDFs and normalized W2; bimodal law를 표현.
papers.ood: 1000 LHS validation points는 같은 input distribution.
papers.verdict: C1/C2 methodological evidence, C3 없음. 통상 deterministic PCE와 달리 unobserved randomness를 latent로 생성.

papers.title: A spectral surrogate model for stochastic simulators computed from trajectory samples
papers.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
papers.model: fixed-seed response functions를 sparse PCE로 표현한 후 KLE로 압축하고 coefficient law를 Gaussian/KDE/vine copula 등으로 학습.
papers.sample: 정적인 borehole water flow. observed rw/hu/kw 고정, hidden R/Tu/Tl/Hl/L 산포→different scalar flow rate.
papers.evidence: fixed-input PDF, normalized Wasserstein, covariance 검증.
papers.ood: genuine external-support OOD experiment 확인 못함.
papers.verdict: C1/C2 strong static statistical example, C3 없음. 제목 trajectory는 parameter-space function f_seed(x)의 추적이며 physical time evolution이 아님.

papers.title: MF-GLaM: A multifidelity stochastic emulator using generalized lambda models
papers.model: GLD-PCE conditional distribution에 low-fidelity information/correction 결합.
papers.sample: same observed rw/hu/kw with hidden five borehole/aquifer parameters→static water-flow law. 추가 seismic peak-drift law.
papers.evidence: Fig.4 fixed-condition PDFs, Fig.5 W2; borehole validation 1000 conditions×10000 seeds.
papers.ood: test input law와 training law 동일, genuine shift 없음.
papers.verdict: C1/C2 strong numerical scalar evidence, C3 없음. low/high fidelity는 OOD domain validation과 별개.

papers.title: Reliability analysis for non-deterministic limit-states using stochastic emulators
papers.access: 최종 출판사 내용 및 title이 다른 arXiv preprint 전문 확인
papers.model: GLaM/SPCE conditional CDFs를 통해 stochastic limit-state failure probabilities 계산.
papers.sample: fixed beam load/length/width/height→static midspan deflection, Young’s modulus는 unobserved random variable. wind-turbine loads도 포함.
papers.evidence: static beam의 analytic failure-probability comparison; wind Fig.7 fixed-speed reference/generated histograms.
papers.ood: extrapolation capability 언급은 있으나 분리된 OOD conditional PDF experiment 미확인.
papers.verdict: user 정의에 정확한 static random-parameter example. C2 static case는 주로 probability/QoI validation; C3 미확인.

papers.title: Seismic fragility analysis using stochastic polynomial chaos expansions
papers.model: SPCE for log(EDP) conditional on ground-motion descriptors; directly samples law and computes fragility.
papers.sample: same seismic intensity/duration/frequency descriptors→different maximum structural response or drift due hidden earthquake realization/seed. 아닌 next-step trajectory prediction.
papers.evidence: Fig.1 four fixed inputs' PDFs, normalized W2; validation 400/200 conditions×250 reference replications.
papers.ood: same input distribution validation; explicit OOD 없음.
papers.verdict: C1/C2 strong scalar engineering one-to-many, C3 없음. data generator가 transient simulation이어도 surrogate target은 scalar conditional law.

papers.title: A Multimodal Conditional Mixture Model With Distribution-Level Physics Priors
papers.venue: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering
papers.access: 저자 preprint 전문 + final publisher abstract 확인; final은 Student-t components도 추가
papers.model: conditional MDN mixture representation with component-weighted physical constraints. preprint Gaussian mixtures, final abstract Gaussian/Student-t; CFM comparator.
papers.sample: fixed control λ with bounded unobserved imperfection→bifurcated steady-state response. 별도로 fixed slow/coarse variable u1→fast variable u2의 stationary conditional law. real shock Hugoniot data도 모델링.
papers.evidence: Fig.3 fixed λ=-0.8/0/0.8 truth-vs-MDN-vs-CFM density. Fig.4 fixed u1=5 및 training 밖 u1=12에서 1000 generated samples와 analytic stationary conditional PDF 대조.
papers.ood: u1=12 outside training range에 conditional PDF verification. engineering shock example의 OOD empirical law까지 검증한 것은 아님.
papers.verdict: non-time-forecast conditional distribution + OOD의 좋은 mathematical benchmark. C1/C2/C3 numerical qualitative evidence 있으나 industrial repeated-measurement validation이나 전체 field joint-law proof는 아님. branch reference sampling rule과 실제 발생빈도 구분.

papers.title: Conditional Pseudo-Reversible Normalizing Flow for Surrogate Modeling in Quantifying Uncertainty Propagation
papers.venue: Journal of Machine Learning for Modeling and Computing 6(4):1–28
papers.access: preprint 전문과 ORNL publication record 확인
papers.model: pseudo-reversible neural maps로 noisy physical model의 conditional law를 직접 학습. function/noise form 사전 지식 없이 likelihood와 reversibility losses 사용.
papers.sample: fixed observed x→different y=f(x)+epsilon(x), Gaussian/Laplace homoscedastic/heteroscedastic data; geological carbon-storage numerical application.
papers.evidence: fixed x에서 20000 generated samples로 PDF/KL 검증. trained x∈[0,1], eval x∈(-1,2).
papers.ood: Fig.3–5 x=-0.8/1.8 outside training domain explicit validation, 그러나 PDF/KL markedly fails.
papers.verdict: exact user problem formulation의 일반 surrogate. C2 ID succeeds, C3 tested failure. OOD 결과가 존재한다는 것과 OOD에서도 분포가 맞는 것은 다름.

papers.title: Generative Neural Operators through Diffusion Last Layer
papers.model: neural operator가 input-dependent low-rank basis를 만들고, frozen encoder coefficients에서 conditional diffusion/flow-matching하여 output function samples 생성.
papers.sample: static stochastic Darcy: same permeability field a(x), hidden random source f(x)→different pressure fields. 이 항목은 정적 Darcy 검증을 중심으로 평가했다.
papers.evidence: 10000 training inputs with one output/input; 32 validation/test inputs with 64 true outputs/input. Energy Distance/Sliced Wasserstein/mean/spread errors로 conditional laws 비교. Darcy Table 3의 DLL mean/spread NRMSE는 0.355/0.357로, 근사 분포 재현이며 정확한 일치는 아님.
papers.ood: stochastic cases에서 explicit distribution-shift OOD protocol 없음. longer deterministic rollout은 별도 평가.
papers.verdict: 고차원 same-input random-field distribution의 직접적 AI 선례. C1/C2 numerical validation, C3 없음. theory의 low-rank 해석과 empirical success를 구분.

papers.title: DeepFracture: A Generative Approach for Predicting Brittle Fractures with Neural Discrete Representation Learning
papers.model: discrete latent autodecoder/VQ and random segment code with geometry/impulse conditioning.
papers.sample: same object/impact→different final 3D fracture patterns. 4 shapes, each 300 BEM collision simulations. graphical fracture synthesis.
papers.evidence: fragment volume CDF vs BEM/Mott, counts/normals across 30 collisions. 서로 다른 impacts pooled comparison.
papers.ood: unseen collision locations/directions/strength visuals, quantitative OOD law 없음; shape별 separate model.
papers.verdict: C1 diverse final shapes, C2 fixed-impact occurrence probability 검증 부족, C3 약함. measured engineering fracture law와 구분.

papers.title: From Sparse AFM Observations to Probabilistic Macroscale Mechanics: A Generative-Physics Framework for Plant Cell Walls
papers.model: Stable Diffusion LoRA-generated AFM-like microstructures→elastic property mapping/homogenization→paired effective-property random field and static FEM.
papers.sample: fixed macroscopic specimen geometry/loading에서 Gauss-point material assignment만 다시 뽑아 peak stress 산포. actual plant AFM images로부터 microstructures 생성.
papers.evidence: 20 macro realizations의 KDE. training 197 images는 6 raw scans의 patches/flips; macro true response distribution 측정 없음. authors explicitly distribution/heldout independence limitations.
papers.ood: genuine OOD 없음; three validation image train membership/biological identity unreported.
papers.verdict: static random-seed pipeline의 최신 후보이지만 C2 ground-truth macro-law 검증 없음, C3 없음. AI-generated variability의 전파만으로 실제 산포를 맞췄다고 할 수 없음.

papers.title: Efficient, scalable emulation of stochastic simulators: A mixture density network based surrogate modeling framework
papers.access: primary publisher abstract/method excerpt 확인; 전문 미확보
papers.model: MDN stochastic surrogate with multitask regularization and Bayesian hyperparameter search. observed x에서 mixture-distribution parameters 추정.
papers.sample: same input parameter에서 repeated stochastic simulator runs yield different output by hidden randomness; academic/engineering cases의 scalar distributions.
papers.evidence: publisher reports small-data 200 and larger 1600–3200 samples regimes의 simulator distribution emulation. exact fixed-x repeat counts/metrics는 full text 미확인.
papers.ood: explicit OOD conditional distribution protocol 미확인.
papers.verdict: 문제 정의가 user 요청과 직접 일치하는 중요한 general engineering surrogate paper. exact applications/validation을 추측하여 채우지 않음.

papers.title: Accelerating Seismic Response Distribution Estimation With Scalable Mixture Density Network Stochastic Surrogate Models
papers.access: primary publisher abstract/record 확인; 전문 미확보
papers.model: MDN conditional EDP-density surrogate. non-replicated training and higher-dimensional ground-motion explanatory variables 지원.
papers.sample: same seismicity/ground-motion features→hidden acceleration realization에 따른 different engineering-demand scalar. fixed-input distribution estimation, time-step prediction 아님.
papers.evidence: primary abstract는 EDP distribution emulation과 scalability를 보고. detailed PDFs/OOD split은 전문에서 추가 확인 필요.
papers.ood: access 가능한 abstract로 genuine OOD 확인 불가.
papers.verdict: direct seed-scatter engineering predecessor 후보. 세 조건 모두 확인된 논문으로 분류하지 않음.

foundations.name: Mixture Density Networks
foundations.description: NN가 mixture weights/means/scales를 예측해 p(y|x)를 만든다. fixed x에서 mixture component와 noise를 뽑아 scalar/vector sample을 생성. 원 논문의 robot inverse kinematics는 이 질의의 forward experimental-scatter 사례와 별개.
foundations.limit: 범용 conditional-density 방법론. engineering 적용/realistic output/OOD 성능은 개별 논문에서 별도 입증해야 한다.

foundations.name: Generalized Additive Models for Location, Scale and Shape (GAMLSS)
foundations.description: location/scale뿐 아니라 shape parameter도 input의 additive function으로 회귀. 선택한 분포의 inverse CDF에서 fixed-x sampling. scalar skewness/tails를 다룰 수 있다.
foundations.limit: 분포족 선택이 중요. 자유로운 high-dimensional physical field law 및 OOD 보장이 자동으로 생기지 않는다.

foundations.name: NGBoost: Natural Gradient Boosting for Probabilistic Prediction
foundations.description: boosted base learners가 conditional distribution parameters를 proper score와 natural gradient로 학습. 평균 추정만이 아니라 predictive distribution을 출력하며 sampling 가능.
foundations.limit: 기본 Gaussian이면 단봉성에 제한. 본 조사 CHF 적용은 coverage/mean validation 중심이며 OOD full-density match는 미입증.

foundations.name: Practical heteroskedastic Gaussian process modeling for large simulation experiments
foundations.description: mean process와 input-dependent noise variance process를 함께 추정하고 반복실험을 효율적으로 이용. ATO manufacturing/inventory simulator에서 고정 정책/재고 input의 random output을 모델링.
foundations.limit: Gaussian observation law 아래 mean/variance 및 proper-score 검증. GP posterior uncertainty of mean와 physical aleatoric noise를 따로 유지해야 한다. Random holdout은 OOD가 아니다.

foundations.name: Quantile Regression Forests
foundations.description: forest weights로 conditional empirical CDF 및 임의 quantiles를 추정. fixed x에서 weighted response 또는 inverse empirical CDF로 sampling.
foundations.limit: scalar distribution baseline으로 유용. 여러 output을 각각 QRF로 학습하면 joint dependence가 보장되지 않으며 observed response support 밖 새 물리모드 생성은 제한적.

foundations.name: Distributional Random Forests: Heterogeneity Adjustment and Multivariate Distributional Regression
foundations.description: MMD splitting으로 mean 외 distribution heterogeneity를 탐지하고 forest weights가 multivariate conditional law를 정의. response vector를 함께 weighted sampling해 dependence를 유지.
foundations.limit: 범용 statistical foundation. 새로운 full-field realizations를 neural generator처럼 합성하는 모델은 아니며 extrapolation/novel modes 검증 필요.

foundations.name: Stochastic Kriging for Simulation Metamodeling
foundations.description: simulation의 intrinsic noise와 unknown response-surface의 extrinsic uncertainty를 구분해 mean performance surrogate 및 실험 설계를 다룬다.
foundations.limit: 관련 기준점이지만 원형 자체를 full-output conditional-distribution generator로 분류하면 안 된다. mean의 posterior draws는 replicate outcome law와 다르다.
